figurative_meaning_en: An elderly person walking with a stick
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের বুড়ো তিনঠেঙে হয়ে ঘুরে বেড়ায়।
সে তিনঠেঙে অবস্থায় পৌঁছে গেছে, আর কাজ করতে পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: The village elder now walks around on three legs.
He has reached the stage of being three-legged and can no longer work.
history: This idiom originates from rural Bengali observations of elderly people using walking sticks, symbolizing the natural progression of age in agrarian societies.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of physical dependency in old age, common in traditional Bengali households.
